note: Round e4 run claims (research/e4/coordinator/DECISIONS.md). A lane launches only IDs listed here at a pushed commit, with launch_runs.py --plan research/e4/plan.json and its own registry research/e4/<lane>/registry.jsonl. Every run starts from a gated e3 start file (--init-weights, fresh Adam, init_age 50,000) on the e1 30% split. IDs: e4-<co|dy|me|au>-<condition>-w<width>-i<init seed>[-...]-a<attempt>. purpose "diagnostic-replay" marks replays of published runs; they are dependent observations, not new seeds.
